subject: website
name: billiard.eth
summary: An online 8-ball pool game tied to ENS names. Its source is public (MIT). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: it relies on a game server (a Cloudflare Worker) that runs the authoritative game, and when it opens it reads a public Ethereum RPC, loads Google Fonts and an ENS avatar host, and its bundled wallet library calls WalletConnect and Coinbase.

connections.name: Game server (billiard-worker.dmpay.workers.dev)
connections.note: Queried when the page opens; it holds the lobby and runs every game.

connections.name: WalletConnect/Reown (api.web3modal.org, pulse.walletconnect.org)
connections.note: Telemetry and wallet list requests from the bundled wallet library, before any wallet is connected.

connections.name: Coinbase wallet telemetry (cca-lite.coinbase.com)
connections.note: Pings from the bundled wallet library when the page opens.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
